# SUMMIT One Vanderbilt

> SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is an immersive multi-sensory art and observation experience atop Manhattan's iconic One Vanderbilt skyscraper, blending architecture, technology, and sustainable tourism.

Located in Midtown Manhattan, SUMMIT features installations by artists like Kenzo Digital, offering 360-degree NYC skyline views from 1,000+ feet above the city. The LEED Gold-certified attraction combines observation decks with immersive art experiences including Transcendence, Affinity, and Après.
